game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: Los Santos (opening act)
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 29 entries from In the Beginning to The Green Sabre: In the Beginning, Big Smoke, Sweet & Kendl, Ryder, Tagging Up Turf, Cleaning the Hood, Drive-Thru, Nines and AK's, Drive-By, Sweet's Girl, Cesar Vialpando, OG Loc, Running Dog, Wrong Side of the Tracks, Just Business, Home Invasion, Catalyst, Robbing Uncle Sam, High Stakes Low-Rider, Life's a Beach, Madd Dogg's Rhymes, Management Issues, House Party, Burning Desire, Gray Imports, Doberman, Los Sepulcros, Reuniting the Families, The Green Sabre. Ends with CJ leaving LS.

findings.name: Countryside / Badlands (Red County, Flint County, Whetstone)
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 14: Badlands, First Date, Tanker Commander, Body Harvest, King in Exile, First Base, Local Liquor Store, Gone Courting, Against All Odds, Made in Heaven, Small Town Bank, Wu Zi Mu, Farewell My Love..., Are You Going to San Fierro? Several (Catalina, The Truth, Woozie) are interleaved with the SF/Desert arcs, so the arc order is not strictly separate. The gta.wiki list does not mark which are optional.

findings.name: San Fierro
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 26: Wear Flowers in Your Hair, 555 We Tip, Deconstruction, Air Raid, Supply Lines..., New Model Army, Back to School (Driving School), Photo Opportunity, Jizzy, T-Bone Mendez, Mike Toreno, Mountain Cloud Boys, Ran Fa Li, Lure, Amphibious Assault, The Da Nang Thang, Outrider, Snail Trail, Ice Cold Killa, Pier 69, Toreno's Last Flight, Yay Ka-Boom-Boom, Zeroing In, Test Drive, Customs Fast Track, Puncture Wounds. Plot: CJ wins a garage (Doherty), tracks Loco Syndicate leader Mike Toreno, who is a government agent. NOTE: Yay Ka-Boom-Boom is listed by gta.wiki under San Fierro; Wikipedia/PowerPyx tie it to the Triad/Wu Zi Mu line and it unlocks Las Venturas and the Freight Train tasks.

findings.name: Desert (Tierra Robada, Bone County)
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 9: Monster, Highjack, Interdiction, Verdant Meadows, Learning to Fly, N.O.E., Stowaway, Black Project, Green Goo. Mike Toreno line. Learning to Fly requires bronze in all flight school lessons (per PowerPyx).

findings.name: Las Venturas
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 18: Fender Ketchup, Explosive Situation, You've Had Your Chips, Don Peyote, Architectural Espionage, Key to Her Heart, Dam and Blast, Cop Wheels, Up Up and Away!, Intensive Care, The Meat Business, Fish in a Barrel, Madd Dogg, Freefall, Misappropriation, High Noon, Saint Mark's Bistro, Breaking the Bank at Caligula's. CJ becomes casino co-owner, plans robbery of Mafia-run casino (heist = Architectural Espionage through Breaking the Bank at Caligula's), saves Madd Dogg from suicide (mission Madd Dogg) and becomes his manager. Saint Mark's Bistro is the Liberty City-themed mafia mission (has an achievement).

findings.name: Return to Los Santos
findings.detail: gta.wiki lists 9: A Home in the Hills, Vertical Bird, Home Coming, Cut Throat Business, Beat Down on B Dup, Grove 4 Life, Riot, Los Desperados, End of the Line. Tenpenny acquittal triggers citywide riot.

findings.name: End of the Line (final mission)
findings.detail: CJ finds Big Smoke's hideout (Smoke's Crack Palace) and kills him. Tenpenny arrives, takes the money, escapes via explosion, flees in a fire truck chased by CJ and Sweet, crashes off a bridge above Grove Street and dies; riot ends. Credits follow (achievement 'Time to Kill' for watching them is Social Club/PC-type).
findings.trackable: Mission completion counted in stats/percentage; achievement 'The End of the Line' exists on DE (Xbox/PS/PC list).

findings.name: Story-related achievements with mission-specific conditions (DE list)
findings.detail: Getting Started (complete Big Smoke); Assassin (stealth-kill every enemy in Madd Dogg's Rhymes); All Dressed Up for San Fierro (complete The Green Sabre); Who Needs Directions? (find Toreno in the Mike Toreno mission without relying on the referenced locations); What happens in Las Venturas... (complete Yay Ka-Boom-Boom); They Can't Stop All of Us (Black Project: reach the underground base without triggering the above-ground alarm); Liberty City State of Mind (complete Saint Mark's Bistro); The End of the Line (complete End of the Line). Green Goo has no listed dedicated achievement.
findings.missable: Mission-specific ones (Assassin, Who Needs Directions?, They Can't Stop All of Us) must be done on the first attempt or retried via Replay Mission; replay availability not confirmed.

findings.name: Story mission count
findings.detail: SOURCES DISAGREE. PowerPyx (DE 100% guide): 98 story missions required + 26 asset missions. gta.wiki: stated total 101 but its own section counts sum to 105 (29+14+26+9+18+9), likely including Driving School/Pier 69/etc. Sportskeeda: 101 incl. opening, or 100; one source 90 main missions. Do NOT use a single number in a trophy without in-game confirmation.

findings.name: 100% completion requirements (non-story)
findings.detail: PowerPyx: 26 asset missions (Courier 3, Trucking 8, Quarry 7, Zero RC 3, Wang Cars 4, Valet 1); vehicle challenges 3 (BMX, NRG-500, Chiliad); vehicle missions 6 (Firefighter, Paramedic, Vigilante, Pimping, Freight Train, Taxi 50 fares); race tournaments (intro says 19, race section says 16 - inconsistent); 6 checkpoint races; 4 stadium events; 33 vehicle school lessons; 100 tags; 50 snapshots; 50 horseshoes; 50 oysters; 3 export lists of 10 cars; 4 shooting range challenges; 24 properties + 5 hotel suites; 3 gyms. Not required: 70 unique jumps, girlfriends, turf takeover. Guide says nothing for 100% is missable.
findings.trackable: Overall percent in Stats menu (user reports).

findings.name: Remastered / ...Here we go again
findings.detail: Remastered: reach 100% completion (100G Gold). ...Here we go again: start a new game after reaching 100% on a save.

findings.name: Ain't Nothing But a G Thing
findings.detail: Own all gang turfs and properties and have $1,000,000 (Gold). Late-game; turf war is not needed for percentage but needed for this achievement.

trackableStats.where: Stats menu (Pause > Stats), per commenters on PowerPyx; people report values like 99.47% and 96.79% in the DE, confirming a numeric percent exists
Believed to be in Stats (original game shows 'Missions Completed'); not verified for DE

versionNotes.note: Achievement list differs per platform: Xbox/PlayStation/PC DE have 34-35 achievements/trophies (1 Platinum 'I Ain't No Buster'), and PC adds 13 Rockstar Social Club-only accomplishments (48 total per gta.wiki). Switch has no in-system achievements/trophies as far as searched; not explicitly confirmed. A Switch 2 upgrade/edition was NOT found in search.
DE added mission-specific achievement conditions (stealth kills, alarm avoidance, finding Toreno) not in the 2004 original.
Switch version launched 11 Nov 2021 (Trilogy), with gyro aiming and touchscreen support.
